text:
maria: Perf CI alert — nightly bench 'lm_incr_batch_16' shows 35% median token latency increase, 3/30 runs failed.
perf-bot: [alert] job=nightly-perf id=18200 status=regression link=https://ci.redwood/company/18200
cj: Thanks. Can someone paste the failing logs? I want to see stacktraces / OOMs.
sahil: Pushing logs here: https://s3.redwood/logs/18200/lm_incr_batch_16.log — it's a stack of KV cache growth + slow decode loop, not an OOM.
lena: Noted. This started after the kvcache-compact change in PR #2345, cc @sahil
maria: Timeline: nightly run at 03:12 UTC, previous nightly (yesterday) passed. PR #2345 landed ~02:50 UTC in master.
ryan: I'll run a quick local repro with the nightly image. Which commit hash for master at the time?
cj: master@f7a1c3b is the head at 02:55 per CI. Use docker image: registry.redwood/nightly:f7a1c3b
ryan: running: 
```
docker run --rm registry.redwood/nightly:f7a1c3b /bin/bash -c "python -m perf_bench --case lm_incr_batch_16 --runs 10"
```
ryan: reproed locally, latency jump and 2 failures. Attaching profiler link: https://profiler.redwood/runs/18200
maria: Any quick mitigations? Can we revert kvcache-compact toggle or pin to old kernel?
sahil: Quick mitigation: set REDWOOD_KVCACHE_COMPACT=false in runtime config; that avoids the slow path.
cj: Can someone try rerunning CI with env override? I can open a PR that sets the flag for nightly until we fully investigate.
lena: I can kick a one-off rerun with the flag, give me 10m.
deploy-bot: started job nightly-perf-rerun-18200 by lena — https://ci.redwood/company/18201
perf-bot: rerun complete — no failures, median latency back to baseline (within 2%).
ryan: good. So it's clearly related to the compact path. I'll bisect PR #2345 to find the exact offending change.
maria: Plan: 1) keep REDWOOD_KVCACHE_COMPACT=false on nightly until fixed, 2) ryan to bisect and open a fix PR, 3) cj to prepare revert PR if bisect point is narrowed to one commit.
sahil: I'll review bisect results and help craft a patch to keep the optimization correct.
cj: I'll open a short-lived revert PR if needed — ping me once bisect identifies suspect commit. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team. Adding notes to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/18200-nightly-kv-compact
ryan: starting bisect now, will report back in ~30m. :eyes:
